# Contributing

Thanks for helping with 3dixel.

## Ways to help

- Report a bug or a wrong instruction in `SKILL.md` with an issue.
- Suggest a new texture, part or rule with an issue first, so it can be talked through before any work.
- Send a pull request for fixes to `SKILL.md`, `README.md` or the files in `core/`.

## Pull requests

- Keep each pull request to one change.
- For changes in `core/`, include a preview or a GIF rendered with `core/render.py` that shows the result.
- New textures and rules should come from a real, finished model, not from a quick test.
- Run `kit.mixels(build_parts())` on every model you change; it must return an empty list.
- Code has no comments; explain the change in the pull request instead.
- By sending a pull request you agree that your work is released under the MIT License.

## Code of conduct

Everyone taking part follows the [Code of Conduct](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).
